source_note.zh: 六层栈是本项目提出的工程扩展（E0），不是正典的固定层次。anchor 仅表示概念关联；正典 H1–H18 与附录 D.7 优先。工程证伪草案须预注册后才能用于正式处置。
source_note.en: The six-layer stack is an engineering extension proposed by this project (E0), not a fixed hierarchy in the canon. An anchor is only a conceptual link; Canon H1–H18 and Appendix D.7 prevail. Engineering falsification drafts require preregistration before formal disposition.

definition.zh: 把认知负荷从信息量转移到结构
definition.en: Shift cognitive load from information volume to structure

anchor.zh: 概念关联：第1章 1.1；工具 A.1（非层定义）
anchor.en: Concept link: Ch.1 §1.1; Tool A.1 (not a layer definition)

layers.evidence: 本框架 E1；机制待核验

falsifier.zh: 工程草案：若结构化压缩相对原文的决策质量提升 d<0.3，则 L1 操作化失败；不自动推翻认知负荷机制。
falsifier.en: Engineering draft: if structured compression improves decision quality over the original text by d<0.3, the L1 operationalization fails; this does not automatically refute cognitive-load mechanisms.

anchor.zh: 概念关联：第3章；第9章 M1（非层定义）
anchor.en: Concept link: Ch.3; Ch.9 M1 (not a layer definition)

layers.evidence: 本框架 E1；机制待核验

falsifier.zh: 工程草案：若干预注册的迁移任务中交互组与静态组无显著差异，则 L2 降为可选增强。
falsifier.en: Engineering draft: if interactive and static groups show no significant difference on preregistered transfer tasks, L2 is demoted to an optional enhancement.

falsifier.zh: 正典 H2：若意义判断方差被单一维度解释>90%，则 H2 被证伪。
falsifier.en: Canon H2: if a single dimension explains >90% of the variance in meaning judgment, H2 is falsified.

definition.en: Label every judgement with its strength of evidence

anchor.zh: 正典第6章 E0–E6；3.3 PE 方程（工程组合）
anchor.en: Canon Ch.6 E0–E6; §3.3 PE equation (engineering combination)

layers.evidence: 本框架 E2（工具）/ E1（模型）

falsifier.zh: 工程草案：若证据等级标注在评审者之间不一致，或与后续检验结果无单调关系，则 L4 失败；H10 另按正典量表信度阈值检验。
falsifier.en: Engineering draft: if evidence labels disagree across reviewers or show no monotone relation to later test outcomes, L4 fails; H10 is tested separately against the canon's scale-reliability threshold.

definition.zh: 在五尺度上选定值得的方向
definition.en: Choose the worthwhile direction across five scales

anchor.zh: 正典第4章；DC 指标；H7/H8（工程组合）
anchor.en: Canon Ch.4; DC index; H7/H8 (engineering combination)

falsifier.zh: 工程草案：若按该层选出的方向在事后评估中不优于基线或随机选择，则 L5 失败；H7/H8 的生存与危机阈值另按正典检验。
falsifier.en: Engineering draft: if directions chosen by this layer do no better than a baseline or random choice in post-hoc evaluation, L5 fails; H7/H8 survival and crisis thresholds are tested separately under the canon.

definition.zh: 让系统审视自己的审视
definition.en: Let the system review its own reviewing

layers.evidence_en: Framework E2; linked to H12/H13 (E2), H14 (E1)

falsifier.zh: 工程草案：若干预注册后续轮次中递归审视的纠错率不高于无审视对照，则 L6 的递归组件失败；归零相关 H12/H13/H14 另按正典阈值检验。
falsifier.en: Engineering draft: if recursive review does not correct earlier errors at a higher rate than a no-review control in preregistered later rounds, the recursive component of L6 fails; zeroing-related H12/H13/H14 are tested separately under the canon.

overload_text.zh: 大模型生成内容爆炸式增长,人类面临严重的认知信息过载。在海量文本洪流中,人类注意力被极大地分散。我们需要快速提取核心意义,真正的价值在于理解与监督……
overload_text.en: Explosive AI-generated content leads to severe cognitive information overload. Human attention is fragmented across vast text streams. Extracting core meaning and staying in the loop is essential...
